limits: This preflight validates source/provenance only; the fit has not run.
The candidate was selected adaptively after results on these observed development cases.
A PASS would establish sufficiency of this bounded local RGB recipe on the observed targets only.
A FAIL after sixteen steps does not prove contextual necessity, global BCE optimality, global IoU optimality or a defective Newton solver.
Initial, trained constant and zero controls are fixed; all twelve cases and both empty cases remain published with probability threshold 0.5.
No independent generalization, Atari mastery, object identities, C/ME, transfer, acceleration or authorization of closed conditional validations follows.
The historical results include other architectures, precisions and recipes; their comparison does not isolate one causal optimizer or contextual effect.
Imports include Torch for inherited runtime/metrics definitions, with construction, forward, backward, loads and optimizers guarded.
